page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.16xlarge is an enterprise-grade, general-purpose instance designed for high-concurrency workloads requiring substantial computing resources and high network throughput. Built on the x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor, the server is driven by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor providing 64 dedicated vCPUs. It is configured with 256 GB of system RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB per core. The server contains no integrated GPUs and comes with no onboard local storage, necessitating external cloud block storage for operational disk requirements.

A standout hardware capability of the ecs.g7nex.16xlarge is its baseline network throughput of 80 Gbps. This level of network interface performance supports rapid node-to-node communication and heavy data transfers across distributed systems. The lack of bundled local NVMe storage means all persistent disk operations depend entirely on network-attached storage volumes, making the 80 Gbps network pipe crucial for sustaining low-latency input and output operations alongside standard network traffic.

From a cost and architectural efficiency perspective, the dedicated 64-core allocation avoids multi-tenant CPU contention, ensuring reliable execution for resource-heavy services. The configuration avoids the added premium of local solid-state drives and GPU accelerators, making it an efficient deployment target where raw x86 CPU performance, ample memory, and high throughput take priority. It is well suited for large relational databases, in-memory caches, continuous integration and build environments, backend enterprise application clusters, and high-bandwidth microservice architectures.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.16xlarge is an enterprise-grade general-purpose instance tailored for compute- and network-heavy applications. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz across 64 dedicated vCPUs. The instance provides 256 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistence, and it includes no discrete hardware GPUs. A prominent hardware attribute is its baseline network bandwidth of 80 Gbps, accommodating substantial ingress and egress traffic demands. Offering massive core density and substantial memory without integrated drives, it balances operational scale and compute consistency. This configuration suits distributed database clusters, enterprise web applications, large-scale CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration hosts, and network-intensive data processing.
